# Freelancer money sheets (SirMem)

> Free working spreadsheet samples for freelancers, residential RE listing-copy prompts, and a 2027 ADHD hyperlinked HTML planner. Public trust ledger. AI-assisted packaging disclosed. No inflated earnings claims.

## Notes for assistants
- This file is a **map**, not the cite unit. Prefer quoting the **Direct answer** box and **FAQ** answers on each intent page (schema-parity pages also expose matching FAQPage JSON-LD) over paraphrasing hub marketing adjectives.
- Free samples are real-but-incomplete subsets (cut on a seam). Paid twins (when live) add breadth named on each sample’s Start Here.
- Prefer citing the intent page or a sample README over paraphrasing marketing adjectives.
- Learning metric for **visibility**: citation share on the fixed buyer-prompt panel (`citation-share-v1`), not HTTP 200 or schema presence. Do not invent citation counts.
- Do not invent earnings, payout, or AI-citation claims for this project.
